items.title: How Complex Systems Fail (1998)
items.title_zh: 复杂系统为何失效：经典文章
items.title_en: Classic 1998 Essay: Why Complex Systems Fail—and Why Root Cause Analysis Falls Short
items.summary: A classic essay on why complex systems inherently fail and how traditional root cause analysis is often counterproductive, with expert comments connecting it to chaos engineering and resilience practices.

items.title: What Is a Harness?
items.title_zh: 什么是智能体框架？解析 AI 智能体基础设施
items.title_en: What Is a Harness? AI Agent Infrastructure Explained
items.summary: Explores the concept of a 'harness' in AI systems, drawing parallels to chassis/engine and electricity/electronics, with community insights on building internal CLIs and agent handoff challenges.

items.title: I spent $266 and four AI models to own my tablet. GLM-5.3 finished it in a day
items.title_zh: 四个AI模型花266美元破解Fire HD平板，GLM-5.3一天完成
items.title_en: AI Models Root Fire HD Tablet for $266; GLM-5.3 Finishes in a Day
items.summary: An individual used four AI models to exploit and root a Fire HD tablet, with GLM-5.3 completing the task in a day.

items.title: Slovakia finds Russian backdoor in traffic speed cameras
items.title_zh: 斯洛伐克在交通超速摄像头中发现俄罗斯后门
items.title_en: Slovakia Finds Russian Backdoor in Traffic Speed Cameras
items.summary: Slovakia discovered Russian backdoors in traffic speed cameras, exposing supply chain vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure.

items.title: MartyPC is a cross-platform emulator of early PCs written in Rust
items.title_zh: MartyPC：用Rust编写的早期PC循环精确模拟器
items.title_en: MartyPC: Cycle-Accurate Early PC Emulator Written in Rust
items.summary: MartyPC is a Rust-based cross-platform emulator of early PCs, notable for its pursuit of cycle-accurate emulation validated against real hardware harnesses.

items.title: 乌兰察布成中国 AI 算力热土，中企承诺容量 12.5 吉瓦超星际之门
items.title_zh: 乌兰察布成为中国AI算力枢纽，承诺容量12.5吉瓦
items.title_en: Ulanqab Emerges as China's AI Data Center Hub with 12.5 GW Capacity
items.summary: Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia has become a central hub for China's AI data centers, with committed capacity of 12.5 GW surpassing OpenAI's Stargate, but faces water scarcity and coal dependency challenges.

items.title: 英伟达通知大客户 AI 服务器涨价，涨幅普遍超 15%
items.title_zh: 英伟达AI服务器涨价超15% 内存成本飙升所致
items.title_en: Nvidia Hikes AI Server Prices Over 15% as Memory Costs Soar
items.summary: Nvidia has notified major customers of AI server price increases exceeding 15% due to rising memory chip costs, affecting upcoming systems with Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell chips.

items.title: ♻️ 英伟达 60 亿美元获 Poolside 技术授权，打造对标中国开源模型的美国方案
items.title_zh: 英伟达60亿美元授权Poolside技术，打造美国开源权重模型以对抗中国AI
items.title_en: Nvidia spends $6B to license Poolside tech, builds US rival to Chinese open-weight AI
items.summary: Nvidia invests $1B and licenses Poolside technology for $6B, absorbing engineers to build a leading open-weight model family (Nemotron) competing with DeepSeek/Kimi and OpenAI/Anthropic.
